core: Neuronal calcium and cAMP signalling to CREB
name: Neuronal calcium-cAMP signalling to CREB and AMPK
rationale: All members describe synaptic calcium/cAMP second-messenger signalling via CaMK and adenylate cyclase to CREB, and the CaMKK-AMPK branch distinguishes it from the synaptic plasticity, memory and NMDA receptor confusables.

qualifier: FGFR2/FGFR3 adaptor cascades and activating point mutants
name: FGFR2/3 adaptor cascades and activating FGFR mutants
rationale: Members are FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and ligand activation of FGFR2 and FGFR3 plus activating point mutants of FGFR1-4, whereas confusables centre on FGFR1/FGFR2 ligand binding, splicing or feedback regulation.

core: Myeloid proinflammatory cytokine and chemokine production
name: Myeloid inflammatory cytokine and chemokine production and restraint
rationale: Members cover proinflammatory cytokine/chemokine output of macrophages, monocytes and dendritic cells and its negative regulation (IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1), distinct from confusables on leukocyte adhesion/extravasation, lymphocyte NF-kB activation or monocyte aggregation.

name: Responses to addictive drugs and reward conditioning
rationale: Members are behavioural and cellular responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine, ethanol and opioids plus conditioned place preference and operant learning, separating it from social behaviour, dopamine receptor and neuropeptide confusables.

qualifier: RNP assembly, viral RNA synthesis and translation
name: Influenza viral RNA synthesis, RNP assembly and translation
rationale: Members describe influenza vRNA/mRNA synthesis, nuclear vRNP assembly, host mRNA processing inhibition and viral translation, unlike the coronavirus replicase, HIV/HCMV integration and latency confusables.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism, catabolism and phenylketonuria plus the general L-amino acid terms that contain them, distinct from histidine/threonine, proline/glycine, BH4 and organic acid confusables.

qualifier: collagen, basement membrane and elastic fibre
name: Collagen, basement membrane and elastic fibre assembly
rationale: Members cover collagen biosynthesis, trimerization and oxidative crosslinking, laminin/basement membrane and anchoring fibril assembly and elastic fibres, whereas confusables emphasise proteoglycans, hemidesmosomes, fibronectin or integrin signalling.

core: Removal of methyl and alkyl groups from DNA
name: DNA dealkylation, cytosine demethylation and methionine salvage
rationale: Members are direct alkylation damage reversal (ALKBH2/3, MGMT), TET/TDG 5-methylcytosine demethylation and methylthioadenosine-to-methionine salvage, distinct from the base excision repair confusables.

core: Host-virus control of RNA and translation
qualifier: coronavirus replication and antiviral nucleotide editing
name: Coronavirus replication, antiviral nucleotide editing and translational repression
rationale: Members combine SARS-CoV replication and host translation hijacking, ADAR/APOBEC editing restricting viruses, and host translational repression, with the editing arm distinguishing it from HIV entry, influenza and viral replication regulation confusables.

qualifier: cationic and neutral, with transporter defects
name: Cationic and neutral amino acid transport and transporter defects
rationale: Members are transport of lysine, arginine, ornithine and neutral/aromatic amino acids plus SLC7A7, SLC25A15, SLC6A14 and SLC22A18 defects, the cationic transport and its disorders distinguishing it from peptide, proline/glycine and inositol/polyamine confusables.

qualifier: inherited factor V, VIII and IX defects
name: Coagulation cascade and inherited factor V, VIII, IX defects
rationale: Members are intrinsic/extrinsic/common coagulation, fibrin formation and contact activation plus many defective F8, F9 and FV variants, the clotting-factor defects distinguishing it from fibrinolysis, platelet, VWF and kallikrein confusables.

name: CSF1 signalling and restraint of myeloid phagocyte activation
rationale: Members centre on M-CSF/CSF1 signalling, macrophage proliferation and myeloid identity with SIRP, interleukin SHC signalling and negative regulation of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, separating it from CSF production/differentiation, IL-6 and DAP12 confusables.

qualifier: promoter escape and early elongation pausing
name: RNA polymerase II initiation, promoter escape and promoter-proximal pausing
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter opening and escape (host and HIV), early elongation complex formation and pausing, unlike the capping, Tat-driven HIV elongation and termination confusables.

name: Sperm motility, mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier
rationale: Members are sperm flagellar motility and cilium movement, sperm mitochondrial sheath organisation and Sertoli cell barrier, distinct from germ cell, axoneme assembly, motile cilia and fertilisation confusables.

qualifier: sister chromatid cohesion, PLK1/Aurora A and spindle checkpoint
name: Sister chromatid cohesion, PLK1/Aurora A and spindle checkpoint
rationale: Members span establishment, maintenance and resolution of sister chromatid cohesion, PLK1/AURKA/NEK mitotic kinases, centrosome separation and the spindle checkpoint, distinct from APC/C degradation and cytokinesis/midzone confusables.

name: Death receptor apoptosis, caspase-8 control and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover Fas/TRAIL/TNF death receptor signalling, procaspase-8 dimerisation and c-FLIP control, BID activation, TRIF/RIPK1 necroptosis and T cell activation-induced death, distinct from the mitochondrial BCL-2/apoptosome confusable and tumour defence/allograft confusables.

name: HIV-1 transcription elongation, pausing and Tat interactions
rationale: All members describe HIV-1 elongation complex formation, arrest/pausing and recovery with or without Tat and Tat-host interactions, whereas confusables cover host Pol II initiation, promoter escape and general elongation control.

qualifier: lysine and arginine methylation with histone demethylation
name: Protein lysine and arginine methylation and histone demethylation
rationale: Members are peptidyl-lysine mono/di/trimethylation, arginine methylation of histones, histone demethylases and methylation of p53/RUNX1 cofactors and CHD1/2, distinguishing it from BAF/NuRD remodeller, PKMT complex and DNA methylation/heterochromatin confusables.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis control
rationale: All members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation (positively and negatively) or apoptosis, unlike confusables on cornification/skin barrier, wound-healing migration and hair follicle development.

name: Cardiac action potential plateau and repolarisation phases
rationale: Members are phases 1-3 of the cardiac action potential and atrial/ventricular repolarisation (with AV node depolarisation), distinct from confusables on phase 0 depolarisation/conduction and K+ channel resting potential.

name: HIV-1 elongation arrest, pausing and recovery
rationale: All three members describe arrest/pausing and recovery of HIV elongating Pol II (with or without Tat), whereas confusables cover host Pol II initiation and elongation, capping, or formation of the HIV elongation complex.

name: Cysteinyl leukotriene biosynthesis and transport
rationale: Members cover leukotriene/eoxin synthesis, LTD4 biosynthesis, leukotriene transport and LTC4-driven IL-4 production, distinct from confusables on LTB4/lipoxin catabolism and eicosanoid or histamine receptors.

name: APC/C-Cdc20 activity and substrate degradation in mitosis
rationale: Members are APC/C:Cdc20 degradation of securin, cyclin B and Nek2A, APC/C phosphorylation and inhibition, and mitotic exit, unlike confusables centred on APC/C:Cdh1 conversion, Cdh1 targets, cyclin A or Emi1.

name: IL-6 signalling via JAK-STAT3 and ERK1/2
rationale: Members are IL-6 signalling, its JAK-STAT3 programme and negative regulation, plus ERK1 and ERK2 activation, distinct from IL-10/IL-12-family, CSF1 and MAPK inactivation confusables.

qualifier: vitamin D, vitamin K and phosphate transport
name: Vitamin D, vitamin K and phosphate in tissue mineralisation
rationale: Members span vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism with gamma-carboxylation, sodium-phosphate transport and FGF/Klotho/PTH control with their defects, and bone, tooth and ectopic mineralisation, distinct from retinoid, bicarbonate/pH, odontogenesis and steroid hormone confusables.
